title: Understanding the Model

title: Effect on Variance
text: Variance is related to the complexity of the model. Removing a variable generally reduces the model's complexity, which can decrease variance.

title: Effect on Bias
text: Bias is related to the accuracy of the model's predictions. Removing a relevant variable can increase bias because the model has less information to make accurate predictions.
